claims.text: Many reviewers report the gel liner dries out quickly, sometimes arriving already dried or cracking within weeks despite tight lids.
Several reviewers praise the rich color payoff and smooth, easy application.
Some reviewers experienced eye irritation, burning, redness, or infection after use.
Reviewers value the natural/organic and cruelty-free formulation.
